mapper.select: SELECT SERVICE_CD, ACCOUNT, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_GOOGLE_LINK_R WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID}
SELECT REFRESH_ENC FROM TB_EEP_GOOGLE_LINK_R WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND SERVICE_CD = #{SERVICE_CD}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_GOOGLE_LINK_R (EMPLY_ID, SERVICE_CD, REFRESH_ENC, ACCOUNT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{EMPLY_ID}, #{SERVICE_CD}, #{REFRESH_ENC}, #{ACCOUNT}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE REFRESH_ENC = VALUES(REFRESH_ENC), ACCOUNT = VALUES(ACCOUNT), REG_DT = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_GOOGLE_LINK_R WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND SERVICE_CD = #{SERVICE_CD}
